notes: ROOT CAUSE (web-client contract mismatch, NOT api): GET /routes/common returns the named envelope { routes: CommonRouteDto[] } (backend ListCommonRoutesResponse(Routes) — confirmed in docs/api.md and api/src/Taxi.Api/Features/Routes/ListCommonRoutes/ListCommonRoutesResponse.cs). client.ts typed it as { items } and getCommonRoutes returned the whole object; useCommonRoutes read data.items -> always [] -> logged-out Home rendered zero route cards -> AC#1 impossible. Same envelope-class bug as the UC-003 getOrder {order} miss; mocked unit tests hid it because the mock returned the wrong { items } shape too. FIX: (1) client.ts ListCommonRoutesResponse now { routes }, getCommonRoutes is async and unwraps -> returns CommonRouteDto[] directly. (2) useCommonRoutes now returns data ?? [] (no .items). (3) CommonRouteDto fields unchanged (laneA4b: id,name,type,priceCzk + optional pickup/dropoff addr+coords + fromZoneId/toZoneId). SECOND CONSUMER FIXED (same root cause, would have broken the confirm-screen cache fallback): useRouteOrder.ts read queryClient.getQueryData<ListCommonRoutesResponse>(['routes','common']) then cached?.items.find(...) — the cache now holds a CommonRouteDto[], so changed to getQueryData<CommonRouteDto[]> + cached?.find(...). RouteOrderPage.test uses nav-state (location.state.route), not the cache, so the primary 3-tap happy path was never broken by this — but a soft-refresh cache fallback was, hence the added useRouteOrder regression test. REGRESSION TESTS: the client test mocks fetch (NOT the whole client) and asserts getCommonRoutes maps the REAL { routes } payload to the array — this is the coverage that was missing and would have caught the original bug. ENVELOPE AUDIT (other client responses typed { items }): ListMyOrdersResponse (orders/mine, GetMyOrderHistory) backend is genuinely { Items, Total, Page, PageSize } — client { items,total,page,pageSize } is CORRECT, left as-is. All other .items consumers in web/src (ListVehicles, ListDrivers, ListOrders/search, useSuggest, useAddressSuggest, board columns) are the standard list-convention { items } endpoints and are correct. routes/common was the sole outlier and is now fixed.
